name: R.E.M.

whyMatters.en: Athens college-rock four that scaled jangle Rickenbacker and mumbled verse into 90s alternative mass: Losing My Religion (1991) and Everybody Hurts (1992) sit beside grunge as the other US alt radio face.
whyMatters.zh: 雅典学院摇滚四人组：把 Rickenbacker jangle 与含糊主歌扩成 90 年代 alternative 大众面——Losing My Religion（1991）与 Everybody Hurts（1992）与 grunge 并列，作另一美国 alt 电台面孔。

lyricQuotes: That's me in the corner / That's me in the spotlight losing my religion

shortBio.en: Athens jangle-alt four; Losing My Religion mandolin hit, Everybody Hurts ballad as 90s alt mass face.
shortBio.zh: 雅典 jangle-alt 四人；Losing My Religion 曼陀林热单，Everybody Hurts 谣曲作 90 年代 alt 大众面孔。

body.en:
Formed 1980 in Athens, Georgia. Murmur (1983) and Document (1987) establish Buck’s arpeggiated Rickenbacker, Stipe’s opaque lyric delivery, Mills high harmony, Berry’s dry drums—college-rock template before major-label scale.

Out of Time (1991) and Automatic for the People (1992) are the mass-alt hinge: Losing My Religion mandolin riff, Everybody Hurts string-backed ballad. Berry exits 1997; band continues as trio until 2011. Craft is jangle and mid-tempo clarity, not grunge soft-loud.
body.zh:
1980 年于乔治亚雅典组建。Murmur（1983）与 Document（1987）确立 Buck 琶音 Rickenbacker、Stipe 不透明吐字、Mills 高和声、Berry 干鼓——学院摇滚模板，在大厂体量之前。

Out of Time（1991）与 Automatic for the People（1992）是大众 alt 铰链：Losing My Religion 曼陀林 riff、Everybody Hurts 弦乐谣曲。Berry 1997 年离队；乐队三人继续至 2011。工艺是 jangle 与中速清晰，非 grunge soft-loud。

note.en: Document breakthrough single; Buck arpeggio + Stipe hook.
note.zh: Document 突破单曲；Buck 琶音 + Stipe 钩子。

note.en: Mandolin riff as 90s alt radio face; Out of Time peak.
note.zh: 曼陀林 riff 作 90 年代 alt 电台面孔；Out of Time 巅峰。

note.en: String ballad; Automatic for the People mass-alt empathy track.
note.zh: 弦乐谣曲；Automatic for the People 大众 alt 共情曲。

title.zh: Jangle 学院摇滚到大众 alt

body.en:
Buck’s Rickenbacker arpeggios and Stipe’s non-literal verses define early R.E.M. before distortion becomes default alt language.

Losing My Religion proves mandolin can lead a global alt single in 1991 beside Nevermind.

Everybody Hurts shows ballad dynamics without soft-loud grunge form.
body.zh:
Buck 的 Rickenbacker 琶音与 Stipe 非字面主歌定义早期 R.E.M.，在失真成为默认 alt 语言之前。

Losing My Religion 证明 1991 年曼陀林可领全球 alt 单曲，与 Nevermind 并列。

Everybody Hurts 展示谣曲动态，不用 grunge soft-loud 曲式。

body.en:
Stipe/Buck/Mills/Berry hold from Murmur through Automatic. Berry retires 1997 after aneurysm; trio era (Up, Reveal) continues without a permanent drummer replacement as bandmember.

Peak citation period is Berry-era 1987–1994.

No classic guitarist fracture—rhythm section stability is the story.
body.zh:
Stipe/Buck/Mills/Berry 从 Murmur 撑到 Automatic。Berry 1997 年因动脉瘤退休；三人期（Up、Reveal）继续，无正式鼓手成员替代。

巅峰引用期是 Berry 时代 1987–1994。

无经典吉他手分裂——节奏组稳定才是故事。

title.en: US alternative before and beside grunge
title.zh: Grunge 之前与并列的美国 alternative

body.en:
Pixies and Nirvana share the 80s/90s US indie-to-major path; R.E.M. supply the jangle/lyric opaque lane.

Radiohead and later UK/US alt cite Automatic-era ballad craft.

College-radio infrastructure debt is concrete: IRS years then Warner mass.
body.zh:
Pixies 与 Nirvana 共享 80/90 年代美国 indie 到大厂路径；R.E.M. 提供 jangle/歌词不透明车道。

Radiohead 与后来英美 alt 引用 Automatic 期谣曲工艺。

学院电台基建债务具体：IRS 年头再到华纳大众。
